newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony unit to sell PlayStation, software in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Sony unit to sell PlayStation, software in Asia.

text.p: Sony Computer Entertainment Inc, a subsidiary of Sony Corp, said on Wednesday it will start selling its game machine and software in Asian markets outside of Japan from early December.
The company's 32-bit game console PlayStation and game software titles will be sold initially in Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand and Malaysia, a company spokesman said.

The PlayStation model tailored for the Asian market will be sold in Hong Kong and Singapore at suggested retail prices equivalent to that of Japan, and slightly higher in Thailand and Malaysia due to import duties, a company statement said.

In light of the flood of unauthorised copies of game titles and "modified" game machines in Asia, the move is also aimed at establishing a structure that protects intellectual property rights, the statement said.
